That last trade wasn't about the setup. It was about the loss before it. The chart looked the same. You didn't.

It is one. Just not the same kind — one is made by the plan, the other by the loss. Making it back isn't a strategy — it's a feeling wearing a position size.

Any entry inside ten minutes of a loss is worth a second look before it's worth a click.
